name: Miami

neighborhoods.name: Coconut Grove
neighborhoods.homes: houses, townhouses and small apartment buildings

housing: Most Miami residents rent, many in condo towers rented out by owners and in older low-rise apartment buildings.

tenantHelp.name: Miami-Dade County Office of Housing Advocacy

climate: Test the air conditioning, look for mold and water stains, and photograph hurricane shutters or impact windows.
fact: In Miami many rentals are condos owned by individuals, so the building's condo association may have its own move-in rules and fees.
